messages.content:
Building the list now: people at Ember Analytics in Boston — sized by what the sources yield, not by a number invented here.
One firm, so the per-firm cap shapes the waves: at most 15 first emails to Ember Analytics in any 30 days — the rest run in later monthly waves, planned that way from the start. Sources, in order: your own LinkedIn export, names you paste, your school's alumni directory, and firm team pages — every name carries its source, and nobody is emailed on a guessed address. The found, trustworthy, and sendable counts come back here before a single draft exists, and drafting starts only when you approve the whole plan.
I want to network into Ember Analytics in Boston.
I'm a junior economics major.

Recorded from your words: background: I'm a junior economics major.; target city: Boston; target firm: Ember Analytics; school year: junior; field of study: economics. These are user-reported constraints, not independently verified credentials. What should we work on next?

I have stopped using the target city in this active conversation and cleared it from this thread's plan and facts. Your education and firm stay on record. Forget only my target city. Keep my education and the firm name.
